title: Air Force going-public plan called off

tellings.quote: he said 2009 to 2010, he was part of an air force going public plan that was called off by a twostar general.

plain: In 2009 and 2010, the Air Force is said to have had a plan to go public about unidentified flying objects, and a two-star general called it off. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this, repeating what a man he names only as Ed told him about taking part in the plan. If true, it would mean disclosure was close and was stopped from inside.
